questions.question: What is a personal profile?

options.A: a short description of a person's character, interests and qualities

questions.correct_answer_text: a short description of a person's character, interests and qualities

steps: A personal profile is a brief description of who you are, your interests and qualities.

questions.explanation: It is used on social media, job applications and websites.

questions.question: What should a personal profile include?

options.A: your name, age, interests, personality traits and goals

questions.correct_answer_text: your name, age, interests, personality traits and goals

steps: A good profile includes basic information, interests, personality and goals.

questions.explanation: It gives a clear picture of who you are.

questions.question: Which of these is a good opening sentence for a personal profile?

options.A: Hi, I'm Sarah and I'm a passionate, creative person who loves reading.
options.C: I went to the shop yesterday.

questions.correct_answer_text: Hi, I'm Sarah and I'm a passionate, creative person who loves reading.

steps: A strong opening introduces your name and key personality traits.

questions.explanation: The opening should grab the reader's attention.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a personal profile?

options.A: to introduce yourself and share your key qualities with others
options.C: to write a letter to a friend
options.D: to describe a place you visited

questions.correct_answer_text: to introduce yourself and share your key qualities with others

steps: The purpose is to present yourself positively and clearly to others.

questions.explanation: It helps others understand who you are quickly.

questions.question: Which adjective best describes a good personal profile?

options.A: honest and positive

questions.correct_answer_text: honest and positive

steps: A good profile is honest about who you are while presenting you positively.

questions.explanation: It should be authentic but also appealing.

questions.question: What is a 'first impression'?

options.A: the opinion someone forms about you when they first meet you
options.B: the first time you eat a meal

questions.correct_answer_text: the opinion someone forms about you when they first meet you

steps: A first impression is the initial opinion someone forms about you.

questions.explanation: First impressions are formed very quickly.

questions.question: Why are first impressions important?

options.A: they are formed quickly and can be hard to change

questions.correct_answer_text: they are formed quickly and can be hard to change

steps: First impressions are formed in seconds and can be difficult to change.

questions.explanation: Research shows they form within seconds.

questions.question: What does 'to come across as' mean?

options.A: to give the impression of being a certain way

questions.correct_answer_text: to give the impression of being a certain way

steps: 'Come across as' means to give a particular impression to others.
solution.summary: come across as = appear to be.

questions.explanation: You come across as friendly and approachable.

questions.question: What does 'to get on well with' mean?

options.A: to have a good relationship with someone

questions.correct_answer_text: to have a good relationship with someone

steps: 'Get on well with' means to have a friendly, harmonious relationship.
solution.summary: get on well with = have a good relationship.

questions.explanation: I get on well with my classmates.

questions.question: What does 'to be into' something mean?

options.A: to be very interested in or enjoy something

questions.correct_answer_text: to be very interested in or enjoy something

steps: 'Be into' means to have a strong interest in or enjoyment of something.

questions.explanation: I'm into music and reading.

questions.question: What does 'to look forward to' mean?

options.A: to feel excited about something that will happen in the future
options.B: to look in front of you

questions.correct_answer_text: to feel excited about something that will happen in the future

steps: 'Look forward to' means to feel pleased and excited about something coming.
solution.summary: look forward to = be excited about.

questions.explanation: I look forward to meeting new people.

questions.question: What does 'to be keen on' mean?

options.A: to be very interested in and enthusiastic about something

questions.correct_answer_text: to be very interested in and enthusiastic about something

steps: 'Be keen on' means to have a strong interest in and enthusiasm for something.
solution.summary: be keen on = be enthusiastic about.

questions.explanation: She is keen on photography and painting.

questions.question: What does 'to get along with' mean?

options.A: to have a friendly relationship with someone

questions.correct_answer_text: to have a friendly relationship with someone

steps: 'Get along with' means to have a good, friendly relationship.
solution.summary: get along with = get on well with.

questions.explanation: I get along with everyone in my class.

questions.question: What is a 'hobby'?

options.A: an activity you do regularly for enjoyment in your free time

questions.correct_answer_text: an activity you do regularly for enjoyment in your free time

steps: A hobby is an activity done regularly for pleasure in free time.

questions.explanation: Reading and painting are common hobbies.

questions.question: What does 'open-minded' mean?

options.A: willing to listen to new ideas and consider different opinions

questions.correct_answer_text: willing to listen to new ideas and consider different opinions

steps: 'Open-minded' means willing to accept and consider new ideas.

questions.explanation: An open-minded person listens to different views.

questions.question: What does 'adaptable' mean?

options.A: able to adjust easily to new situations

questions.correct_answer_text: able to adjust easily to new situations

steps: 'Adaptable' means able to change and adjust to new conditions.

questions.explanation: Adaptable people handle change well.

questions.question: What does 'to set goals' mean?

options.A: to decide what you want to achieve in the future

questions.correct_answer_text: to decide what you want to achieve in the future

steps: 'Set goals' means to decide on specific targets you want to reach.

questions.explanation: Setting goals helps you stay focused and motivated.

questions.question: What does 'self-confident' mean?

options.A: believing in your own abilities and qualities

questions.correct_answer_text: believing in your own abilities and qualities

steps: 'Self-confident' means having confidence in your own abilities and judgement.

questions.explanation: A self-confident person speaks clearly and calmly.

questions.question: What does 'motivated' mean?

options.A: having a strong desire and energy to achieve something

questions.correct_answer_text: having a strong desire and energy to achieve something

steps: 'Motivated' means having the desire and energy to do something.

questions.explanation: Motivated students work hard to achieve their goals.

questions.question: What does 'creative' mean?

options.A: having the ability to use imagination to produce new ideas

questions.correct_answer_text: having the ability to use imagination to produce new ideas

steps: 'Creative' means having the ability to think of new and original ideas.

questions.explanation: Creative people enjoy art, music and writing.

questions.question: What does 'reliable' mean?

options.A: dependable and able to be trusted

questions.correct_answer_text: dependable and able to be trusted

steps: 'Reliable' means trustworthy and able to be depended on.

questions.explanation: A reliable person always keeps their promises.

questions.question: What does 'to be good at' mean?

options.A: to have a natural ability or skill in something

questions.correct_answer_text: to have a natural ability or skill in something

steps: 'Be good at' means to have a natural skill or ability in a particular area.
solution.summary: be good at = have skill in.

questions.explanation: She is good at mathematics and science.

questions.question: What does 'to be afraid of' mean?

options.A: to feel fear or worry about something

questions.correct_answer_text: to feel fear or worry about something

steps: 'Be afraid of' means to feel fear or anxiety about something.

questions.explanation: Some people are afraid of spiders or the dark.

questions.question: What does 'to be proud of' mean?

options.A: to feel pleased and satisfied about something you have achieved

questions.correct_answer_text: to feel pleased and satisfied about something you have achieved

steps: 'Be proud of' means to feel pleasure and satisfaction about an achievement.
solution.summary: be proud of = feel satisfied about.

questions.explanation: I am proud of my exam results.

questions.question: Which sentence is a good way to describe a hobby?

options.A: I'm really into playing football and I play every weekend.

questions.correct_answer_text: I'm really into playing football and I play every weekend.

steps: A good description uses interest phrases like 'be into' and adds detail.

questions.explanation: This makes the description more interesting.

questions.question: What is the correct structure for a personal profile?

options.A: introduction, hobbies and interests, personality traits, goals

questions.correct_answer_text: introduction, hobbies and interests, personality traits, goals

steps: A personal profile typically has four main sections: intro, hobbies, personality and goals.

questions.explanation: This structure gives a clear, complete picture.

questions.question: Which phrase is used to describe personality?

options.A: I would describe myself as hard-working and friendly.

questions.correct_answer_text: I would describe myself as hard-working and friendly.

steps: 'I would describe myself as...' introduces personality traits clearly.

questions.explanation: This is a standard way to present personality.

questions.question: What does 'to be interested in' mean?

options.A: to want to learn more about something

questions.correct_answer_text: to want to learn more about something

steps: 'Be interested in' means to want to know more about or enjoy something.
solution.summary: be interested in = want to learn about.

questions.explanation: I am interested in science and technology.

questions.question: What does 'to be fond of' mean?

options.A: to like something or someone very much

questions.correct_answer_text: to like something or someone very much

steps: 'Be fond of' means to have a liking or affection for something.
solution.summary: be fond of = like very much.

questions.explanation: She is fond of animals and nature.

questions.question: What does 'to take part in' mean?

options.A: to join in an activity or event

questions.correct_answer_text: to join in an activity or event

steps: 'Take part in' means to participate in an activity or event.

questions.explanation: I take part in school drama productions.

questions.question: What does 'to be able to' mean?

options.A: to have the skill or opportunity to do something
options.B: to be unable to do something

questions.correct_answer_text: to have the skill or opportunity to do something

steps: 'Be able to' means to have the ability or opportunity to do something.

questions.explanation: I am able to speak two languages.

questions.question: What does 'to be good at dealing with' mean?

options.A: to handle difficult situations well
options.B: to be bad at handling things

questions.correct_answer_text: to handle difficult situations well

steps: 'Good at dealing with' means skilled at handling or managing situations.
solution.summary: good at dealing with = handle well.

questions.explanation: I am good at dealing with pressure.

questions.question: What does 'to be well-known for' mean?

options.A: to be famous or recognised for a particular quality or action

questions.correct_answer_text: to be famous or recognised for a particular quality or action

steps: 'Well-known for' means famous or recognised because of something.

questions.explanation: She is well-known for her kindness.

questions.question: Which is the best way to end a personal profile?

options.A: I'm looking forward to meeting new people and learning new things.

questions.correct_answer_text: I'm looking forward to meeting new people and learning new things.

steps: A positive closing statement leaves a good final impression.

questions.explanation: It shows enthusiasm and openness.

questions.question: What does 'to be creative' mean in a personal profile?

options.A: to enjoy coming up with new ideas and expressing yourself

questions.correct_answer_text: to enjoy coming up with new ideas and expressing yourself

steps: Being creative means enjoying new ideas and original thinking.

questions.explanation: It is a positive personality trait to mention.

questions.question: What does 'to be hard-working' mean?

options.A: to put a lot of effort into your work

questions.correct_answer_text: to put a lot of effort into your work

steps: 'Hard-working' means putting a lot of effort and time into tasks.

questions.explanation: Hard-working students achieve more.

questions.question: What does 'to be honest' mean in a personal profile?

options.A: to tell the truth and be sincere about who you are

questions.correct_answer_text: to tell the truth and be sincere about who you are

steps: Being honest means telling the truth and being genuine.

questions.explanation: Honesty is an important quality in a profile.

questions.question: What does 'to be curious' mean?

options.A: to want to learn and know more about things

questions.correct_answer_text: to want to learn and know more about things

steps: 'Curious' means wanting to learn and discover new things.

questions.explanation: Curious people ask lots of questions.

questions.question: What does 'to be sociable' mean?

options.A: to enjoy being with other people and making friends

questions.correct_answer_text: to enjoy being with other people and making friends

steps: 'Sociable' means enjoying the company of other people.

questions.explanation: Sociable people enjoy parties and gatherings.

questions.question: What does 'to be dependable' mean?

options.A: to be reliable and trustworthy

questions.correct_answer_text: to be reliable and trustworthy

steps: 'Dependable' means reliable and worthy of trust.

questions.explanation: A dependable friend always keeps promises.
